import { spawn } from 'node:child_process';

// Generated by superskill install — do not edit manually.
// Plugin: %%PLUGIN_COMMENT%%
// Event: %%EVENT%% (canonical %%CANONICAL_EVENT_COMMENT%%, matcher %%MATCHER_COMMENT%%)
// Command: %%COMMAND_COMMENT%%
//
// Native Pi extension (ADR-039): runs the hook command with the Pi event on stdin and
// SUPERSKILL_HOOK_HOST=pi, then applies its decision — {"decision":"deny|block|ask","reason"}
// on stdout, a Claude-style PreToolUse permissionDecision, or exit 2 + stderr. Anything else,
// a spawn failure, a timeout or a crash allows (fail open).

const EVENT = %%EVENT_LITERAL%%;
const CANONICAL_EVENT = %%CANONICAL_EVENT_LITERAL%%;
const MATCHER = %%MATCHER_LITERAL%%;
// A hooks.json command is a shell command line on every host; run it through the shell too.
const COMMAND = %%COMMAND_LITERAL%%;
const TIMEOUT_MS = %%TIMEOUT_MS%%;
const LABEL = %%LABEL_LITERAL%%;
const CUSTOM_TYPE = 'superskill-hook';
// Pi tool name → canonical (Claude) name, so a canonical matcher like `Glob` or `Write|Edit` fires.
const CANONICAL_TOOLS = { read: 'Read', write: 'Write', edit: 'Edit', bash: 'Bash', grep: 'Grep', find: 'Glob', ls: 'LS' };

function runHook(payload, cwd) {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const allow = { code: 0, stdout: '', stderr: '' };
    let input;
    try {
      input = JSON.stringify(payload);
    } catch {
      resolve(allow);
      return;
    }
    let child;
    try {
      child = spawn(COMMAND, {
        shell: true,
        // Own process group (POSIX), so a timeout kills the shell and everything it started.
        detached: process.platform !== 'win32',
        cwd: cwd || process.cwd(),
        env: { ...process.env, SUPERSKILL_HOOK_HOST: 'pi', SUPERSKILL_HOOK_EVENT: CANONICAL_EVENT },
        stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
      });
    } catch {
      resolve(allow);
      return;
    }
    let stdout = '';
    let stderr = '';
    let settled = false;
    const finish = (result) => {
      if (settled) return;
      settled = true;
      clearTimeout(timer);
      resolve(result);
    };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      try {
        if (process.platform === 'win32' || !child.pid) child.kill('SIGKILL');
        else process.kill(-child.pid, 'SIGKILL');
      } catch {
        // already gone
      }
      child.stdout.destroy();
      child.stderr.destroy();
      finish(allow);
    }, TIMEOUT_MS);
    child.stdout.on('data', (chunk) => {
      stdout += chunk;
    });
    child.stderr.on('data', (chunk) => {
      stderr += chunk;
    });
    child.on('error', () => finish(allow));
    child.on('close', (code) => finish(code === 0 || code === 2 ? { code, stdout, stderr } : allow));
    child.stdin.on('error', () => {});
    child.stdin.end(input);
  });
}

function text(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() ? value.trim() : '';
}

/** The hook's verdict: { decision: 'deny' | 'ask', reason } or null (allow / no objection). */
function verdictOf(result) {
  if (result.code === 2) {
    return { decision: 'deny', reason: text(result.stderr) || text(result.stdout) || `Blocked by ${LABEL}` };
  }
  let parsed;
  try {
    parsed = JSON.parse(result.stdout);
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
  if (!parsed || typeof parsed !== 'object') return null;
  const native = parsed.hookSpecificOutput;
  if (native && typeof native === 'object' && native.updatedInput === undefined) {
    const decision = native.permissionDecision;
    if (decision === 'deny' || decision === 'ask') {
      return { decision, reason: text(native.permissionDecisionReason) || text(parsed.systemMessage) };
    }
  }
  const decision = parsed.decision;
  if (decision === 'deny' || decision === 'block') return { decision: 'deny', reason: text(parsed.reason) };
  if (decision === 'ask') return { decision: 'ask', reason: text(parsed.reason) };
  return null;
}

function notify(ctx, message) {
  if (ctx && ctx.hasUI && ctx.ui && typeof ctx.ui.notify === 'function') ctx.ui.notify(message, 'warning');
}

export default function (pi) {
  // Claude's `stop_hook_active`: true for the Stop that ends a run this hook itself continued.
  let continued = false;

  pi.on(EVENT, async (event, ctx) => {
    if (MATCHER && (EVENT === 'tool_call' || EVENT === 'tool_result')) {
      const tool = String(event.toolName);
      const pattern = new RegExp(MATCHER, 'i');
      if (!pattern.test(tool) && !pattern.test(CANONICAL_TOOLS[tool] || '')) return undefined;
    }
    // Our own continuation re-enters as an extension-sourced prompt; it is not user input.
    if (EVENT === 'input' && event.source === 'extension') return undefined;

    const payload = { ...event };
    const sessionId = ctx && ctx.sessionManager && typeof ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId === 'function'
      ? ctx.sessionManager.getSessionId()
      : undefined;
    if (sessionId) payload.sessionId = sessionId;
    if (EVENT === 'agent_end') {
      payload.stop_hook_active = continued;
      continued = false;
    }

    const verdict = verdictOf(await runHook(payload, ctx && ctx.cwd));
    if (!verdict) return undefined;
    const reason = verdict.reason || `${verdict.decision === 'ask' ? 'Confirmation requested' : 'Blocked'} by ${LABEL}`;

    if (EVENT === 'tool_call') {
      if (verdict.decision === 'deny') return { block: true, reason };
      if (!ctx || !ctx.hasUI) {
        return { block: true, reason: `${reason} (confirmation required, but Pi has no interactive UI in this mode)` };
      }
      const ok = await ctx.ui.confirm(`${LABEL}: allow ${event.toolName}?`, reason);
      return ok ? undefined : { block: true, reason: `Declined by user: ${reason}` };
    }
    // Outside PreToolUse an `ask` has nothing to confirm: it allows, as on every host.
    if (verdict.decision === 'ask') return undefined;

    if (EVENT === 'agent_end') {
      // Stop continuation: queue the reason as a follow-up; Pi runs another turn with it.
      continued = true;
      pi.sendMessage({ customType: CUSTOM_TYPE, content: reason, display: true }, { deliverAs: 'followUp', triggerTurn: true });
      return undefined;
    }
    if (EVENT === 'tool_result') {
      // PostToolUse block: the tool already ran; feed the reason back with its result.
      const content = Array.isArray(event.content) ? event.content : [];
      const result = { content: [...content, { type: 'text', text: `[${LABEL}] ${reason}` }] };
      // Pi 1.x drops a tool's structuredContent when a handler replaces content without it.
      if (event.structuredContent !== undefined) result.structuredContent = event.structuredContent;
      return result;
    }
    if (EVENT === 'input') {
      notify(ctx, reason);
      return { action: 'handled' };
    }
    // Session events cannot be vetoed by a hook (as on Claude Code): surface the reason only.
    notify(ctx, reason);
    return undefined;
  });
}
